title: Settings
readerFooter: Manga and books are both always here. This decides which comes first: the order of the tabs, and the one the app opens on.
contentFooterNoSwitch: Sources marked 18+ are not available in this app.
contentFooterWithSwitch: Sources marked 18+ stay out of Discover and Sources until you turn this on.
libraryFooter: Choose what happens to a series when you add it to your library. Create categories from the Library menu.
readingFooter: A series keeps its own mode once you change it in the reader.
leftEdgeForwardHint: In paged reading, tap the left edge for the next page.
booksFooter: How a book opens. Once you are in a book, its Text and theme sheet changes these for you as you read.
readAloudFooter: Books are read in a voice that runs on this phone. Download a voice model once. Reading aloud then needs no network.
noVoiceModelYet: None yet. Choose one to download.
updatesFooter: Akidev checks the series in your library in the background when your phone allows it, usually a few times a day and less if you rarely open the app. The check asks your sources for new chapters and sends nothing else. The alert is made on this device.
newChapterAlertsHint: A notification when a series in your library gets a chapter.
downloadNewChaptersHint: Keeps them on this device to read offline.
yourDataFooter: A backup holds your library, what you have read, categories, repositories and source settings. Sources come back from their repositories.
aboutCredits: Icons: Solar by 480 Design, CC BY 4.0.
aboutFontCredit: Type: Nunito, SIL Open Font License.
aboutDescription: A reader with no content of its own. Sources come from repositories you add. The people who make them, and the sites they read, are not affiliated with Akidev.
glassFooter: Controls show what is behind them, bent like glass. Turn on Reduce glass if this phone feels slow: controls become plain shapes.
notificationsOffMessage: Turn them on for Akidev in the Settings app, then try again.
notBookOrComic: “{name}” is not a book or a comic. Akidev opens EPUB books, CBZ comics and shared series.
androidCouldNotReadFile: Android did not let Akidev read that file. Try opening it again.
browserCheckTitle: This site needs a browser check
browserCheckMessage: {host} asks for a browser check before it answers, and Akidev cannot pass it. Try another source, or read this one through a Suwayomi or Komga server you run.
couldNotReachMessage: {host} did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
